public_size_field: width; the flattening stride is width, never height
starts: top-left and bottom-right; swapping seats exchanges identity only
diamond_placement: uniform distinct sample outside both safe zones, Manhattan distance at least 6 from both starts
mine_placement: uniform fixed-size sample excluding the predetermined safe zones and all initial diamonds
zero_expansion: at initialization from both starts and upon every safe arrival; reveal only, never collect remotely
mine_effect: consume one life, permanently expose mine; respawn at own starting corner if lives remain, otherwise eliminate
turn_after_surviving_explosion: opponent acts if alive; otherwise the surviving actor acts again
scoring: one point only on actual arrival at a remaining diamond; previous score survives explosions
win_criterion: diamond count only; equal counts draw

classic_v2.first_click: deferred uniform mine placement excluding first cell and its in-bounds neighbors
classic_v2.chord: revealed positive number with matching neighboring flag count opens all unflagged hidden neighbors; wrong flags can explode
classic_v2.terminal_loss_display: reveal all mines after classic loss only, never in arena observations

legacy_compatibility: Arena(seed) and Classic(seed) retain v1 defaults, public fields, placement and outcomes; new behavior requires a named v2 preset
